## Overview `/v1/chat/completions/derender` now fills `usage.completion_tokens_details.reasoning_tokens` from the reasoning parser and `usage.prompt_tokens_details` from the generate usage, in batch and stream mode, as `/v1/chat/completions` does. Fixes #64038 ## Claims - Batch and stream chat derender report `completion_tokens_details.reasoning_tokens` when a reasoning parser is configured. Before: `null`. - Both pass `prompt_tokens_details` through from the generate usage. Before: `null`. - Stream with `n > 1` keeps `completion_tokens_details` `null` (see Details). - 3 new tests (fail on the base commit, pass here), 2 extended; both derender test files pass in full. ## Validation CPU only. Render server on main at 39e6a1aafc (before) and on this branch (after); the generate usage is hand-built with `cached_tokens: 8`. ```bash vllm launch render Qwen/Qwen3-0.6B --port 18100 --reasoning-parser qwen3 ``` ```bash python usage.py ```
usage.py ```python import json import sys import requests from transformers import AutoTokenizer from vllm.parser import ParserManager BASE = sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv) > 1 else "http://localhost:18100" M = "Qwen/Qwen3-0.6B" tok = AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained(M) def post(path, body): r = requests.post(BASE + path, json=body) r.raise_for_status() return r.json() chat = {"model": M, "messages": [{"role": "user", "content": "Say hello"}], "max_tokens": 64} gen_req = post("/v1/chat/completions/render", chat) prompt_ids = gen_req["token_ids"] out_ids = tok.encode( "\nThe user wants a greeting.\n\n\nHello!", add_special_tokens=False ) + [tok.convert_tokens_to_ids("<|im_end|>")] gen_usage = { "prompt_tokens": len(prompt_ids), "completion_tokens": len(out_ids), "total_tokens": len(prompt_ids) + len(out_ids), "prompt_tokens_details": {"cached_tokens": 8}, } choice = {"index": 0, "token_ids": out_ids, "finish_reason": "stop"} batch = post("/v1/chat/completions/derender", { "model": M, "chat_request": chat, "prompt_token_ids": prompt_ids, "generate_response": {"request_id": "b", "usage": gen_usage, "choices": [choice]}, }) stream = post("/v1/chat/completions/derender", { "stream": True, "model": M, "chat_request": {**chat, "stream": True}, "prompt_token_ids": prompt_ids, "generate_chunk": {"request_id": "s", "usage": gen_usage, "choices": [choice]}, }) print("message:", json.dumps(batch["choices"][0]["message"], ensure_ascii=False)) print("derender batch usage:", json.dumps(batch["usage"])) print("derender stream usage:", json.dumps(stream["chunk"]["usage"])) parser = ParserManager.get_parser(reasoning_parser_name="qwen3", tokenizer=tok)(tok, None) print( "coupled /v1/chat/completions would report (computed with the parser, not run): " f"prompt_tokens={len(prompt_ids)}, " f"completion_tokens_details.reasoning_tokens={parser.count_reasoning_tokens(out_ids)}, " "prompt_tokens_details.cached_tokens=8 (with --enable-prompt-tokens-details)" ) ```
Before: ```text derender batch usage: {"prompt_tokens": 0, "total_tokens": 13, "completion_tokens": 13, "prompt_tokens_details": null, "completion_tokens_details": null} derender stream usage: {"prompt_tokens": 10, "total_tokens": 23, "completion_tokens": 13, "prompt_tokens_details": null, "completion_tokens_details": null} coupled /v1/chat/completions would report (computed with the parser, not run): prompt_tokens=10, completion_tokens_details.reasoning_tokens=7, prompt_tokens_details.cached_tokens=8 (with --enable-prompt-tokens-details) ``` After: ```text derender batch usage: {"prompt_tokens": 0, "total_tokens": 13, "completion_tokens": 13, "prompt_tokens_details": {"cached_tokens": 8, "created_cache_tokens": null, "multimodal_tokens": null}, "completion_tokens_details": {"reasoning_tokens": 7}} derender stream usage: {"prompt_tokens": 10, "total_tokens": 23, "completion_tokens": 13, "prompt_tokens_details": {"cached_tokens": 8, "created_cache_tokens": null, "multimodal_tokens": null}, "completion_tokens_details": {"reasoning_tokens": 7}} coupled /v1/chat/completions would report (computed with the parser, not run): prompt_tokens=10, completion_tokens_details.reasoning_tokens=7, prompt_tokens_details.cached_tokens=8 (with --enable-prompt-tokens-details) ``` Stream with `n = 2`: the usage chunk arrives with one index's `stream_state`, so a count there covers that index only (3 or 9 here, where coupled reports the sum, 12) while `completion_tokens` from generate covers both. The details stay `null` instead of a partial number, with either index's state:
n2_stream.py and output ```python """Stream with n=2: send one chunk with for each index, then send the usage chunk with index 0's stream_state. Compares usage.completion_tokens_details.reasoning_tokens with the sum of the reasoning tokens over both indices. """ import json import sys import requests from transformers import AutoTokenizer from vllm.parser import ParserManager BASE = sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv) > 1 else "http://localhost:18100" M = "Qwen/Qwen3-0.6B" tok = AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained(M) def post(path, body): r = requests.post(BASE + path, json=body) r.raise_for_status() return r.json() chat = {"model": M, "messages": [{"role": "user", "content": "Say hello"}], "n": 2, "stream": True, "stream_options": {"include_usage": True}} gen_req = post("/v1/chat/completions/render", chat) prompt_ids = gen_req["token_ids"] end = tok.convert_tokens_to_ids("<|im_end|>") out0 = tok.encode("\nShort.\n\n\nHi!", add_special_tokens=False) + [end] out1 = tok.encode("\nA much longer thought about greetings here.\n\n\nHello there!", add_special_tokens=False) + [end] parser = ParserManager.get_parser(reasoning_parser_name="qwen3", tokenizer=tok)(tok, None) r0 = parser.count_reasoning_tokens(out0) r1 = parser.count_reasoning_tokens(out1) states = {} for idx, ids in ((0, out0), (1, out1)): resp = post("/v1/chat/completions/derender", { "stream": True, "model": M, "chat_request": chat, "prompt_token_ids": prompt_ids, "prompt_tokens": len(prompt_ids), "generate_chunk": {"request_id": "n2", "choices": [ {"index": idx, "token_ids": ids, "finish_reason": "stop"}]}, }) states[idx] = resp["stream_state"] gen_usage = { "prompt_tokens": len(prompt_ids), "completion_tokens": len(out0) + len(out1), "total_tokens": len(prompt_ids) + len(out0) + len(out1), } for idx in (0, 1): resp = post("/v1/chat/completions/derender", { "stream": True, "model": M, "chat_request": chat, "prompt_token_ids": prompt_ids, "prompt_tokens": len(prompt_ids), "stream_state": states[idx], "generate_chunk": {"request_id": "n2", "choices": [], "usage": gen_usage}, }) print(f"usage chunk sent with state of index {idx}:", json.dumps(resp["chunk"]["usage"])) print(f"index 0 reasoning_tokens={r0}, index 1 reasoning_tokens={r1}, coupled would report sum={r0 + r1}") print(f"completion_tokens from generate (both indexes) = {len(out0) + len(out1)}") ``` ```text usage chunk sent with state of index 0: {"prompt_tokens": 10, "total_tokens": 35, "completion_tokens": 25, "prompt_tokens_details": null, "completion_tokens_details": null} usage chunk sent with state of index 1: {"prompt_tokens": 10, "total_tokens": 35, "completion_tokens": 25, "prompt_tokens_details": null, "completion_tokens_details": null} index 0 reasoning_tokens=3, index 1 reasoning_tokens=9, coupled would report sum=12 completion_tokens from generate (both indexes) = 25 ```
The 3 new tests on the base commit 39e6a1aafc (test files copied over) and on this branch: ```bash pytest tests/entrypoints/scale_out/derender/test_derender.py -k test_e2e_parsed_usage_details pytest tests/entrypoints/scale_out/derender/test_derender_stream.py -k test_stream_parsed_usage_details ``` Before: ```text > assert usage["completion_tokens_details"]["reasoning_tokens"] == reasoning_tokens E TypeError: 'NoneType' object is not subscriptable FAILED tests/entrypoints/scale_out/derender/test_derender.py::test_e2e_parsed_usage_details 1 failed, 90 deselected, 14 warnings in 32.91s > assert usage["completion_tokens_details"]["reasoning_tokens"] == reasoning_tokens E TypeError: 'NoneType' object is not subscriptable > assert usage["prompt_tokens_details"]["cached_tokens"] == 4 E TypeError: 'NoneType' object is not subscriptable FAILED tests/entrypoints/scale_out/derender/test_derender_stream.py::test_stream_parsed_usage_details FAILED tests/entrypoints/scale_out/derender/test_derender_stream.py::test_stream_parsed_usage_details_n_gt_1_no_reasoning_tokens 2 failed, 122 deselected, 14 warnings in 32.80s ``` After: ```text 1 passed, 90 deselected, 14 warnings in 33.98s 2 passed, 122 deselected, 14 warnings in 33.23s ``` Both files in full on this branch: ```bash pytest tests/entrypoints/scale_out/derender/test_derender.py pytest tests/entrypoints/scale_out/derender/test_derender_stream.py ``` ```text 91 passed, 14 warnings in 227.08s (0:03:47) 123 passed, 1 xfailed, 14 warnings in 151.96s (0:02:31) ``` ## Details `/v1/chat/completions` counts `reasoning_tokens` with the reasoning parser and keeps the generate server's `cached_tokens`; both derender paths built `UsageInfo` from the token counts alone ([`derender/serving.py` L183-L192](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/blob/39e6a1aafcaea1b90c515dacfc3a20835756758c/vllm/entrypoints/scale_out/derender/serving.py#L183-L192), [`online_derenderer.py` L888-L897](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/blob/39e6a1aafcaea1b90c515dacfc3a20835756758c/vllm/renderers/online_derenderer.py#L888-L897)). Batch now counts in `_parse_and_assemble` with the parser that parsed the choice; stream counts over every token streamed so far on the usage chunk, and `prompt_tokens_details` passes through from the generate usage. With `n > 1` the stream usage chunk carries one index's `stream_state`, so the count can't cover every choice; `completion_tokens_details` stays `null` there, documented in `derenderer.md`. Out of scope: batch `prompt_tokens` still defaults to 0 without `request.prompt_tokens`, and `output_mode="derender"` on `/inference/v1/generate` (#63103). A generate server with `--enable-prompt-tokens-details` and the GPU parity test were not run. ---

@sagearc Mostly a missing field. For `n = 1` the state contract is enough: replay rebuilds the parser and the count matches `/v1/chat/completions`.

`n > 1` is a real contract gap: `stream_state` is per index, but usage needs a total over all choices. Fixing it means changing the contract, which I'd rather not do in a bugfix PR, so this PR leaves it `null`.

     --8<-- "vllm/entrypoints/scale_out/token_in_token_out/protocol.py:derender-chat-request"
     ```
 
+In the response, `usage.prompt_tokens_details` is copied from `generate_response.usage`. When a reasoning parser is configured, `usage.completion_tokens_details.reasoning_tokens` is the number of reasoning tokens summed over all choices, as on `/v1/chat/completions`.

 `/v1/completions/derender`:
 
 ??? code
@@ -116,7 +118,7 @@ The server keeps no state between calls. Everything the next call needs is in `s
 - **Echo `stream_state` back.** Leave it out (or send `null`) on the first call, then send the `stream_state` from each response with the next request, unchanged. State that doesn't add up (e.g. `output_chunk_lens` that don't sum to the number of output tokens) is rejected with a `400`.
 - **One choice per chunk.** `/inference/v1/generate` sends one choice per SSE event and each derender call accepts at most one. More than one is rejected with a `400`.
 - **`n > 1` is N streams.** Generate interleaves chunks for different choices and tags each with its `index`. Keep one `stream_state` per index and send each chunk with the state for its index. Each index gets its own `role` delta on its first chunk.
-- **Send every chunk through, including the last ones.** The finish reason usually arrives with the final tokens. A chunk with a `finish_reason` and no tokens is accepted too and flushes any buffered tool call arguments. With `stream_options: {"include_usage": true}`, generate ends with a usage only chunk (`choices: []`). Send it through derender like any other chunk to get the usage chunk for the response. `usage.prompt_tokens` is the request's `prompt_tokens` if set, otherwise the generate chunk's.

A chunk with a `finish_reason` and no tokens is accepted too and flushes any buffered tool call arguments. With `stream_options: {"include_usage": true}`, generate ends with a usage only chunk (`choices: []`). Send it through derender like any other chunk to get the usage chunk for the response. `usage.prompt_tokens` is the request's `prompt_tokens` if set, otherwise the generate chunk's. `usage.prompt_tokens_details` is the generate chunk's. `usage.completion_tokens_details.reasoning_tokens` is counted by the reasoning parser over the tokens in `stream_state` when one is configured, as on `/v1/chat/completions`. With `n > 1` it stays `null`: the usage chunk arrives with one index's `stream_state`, so the count can't cover every choice the way `completion_tokens` does.
 - **Send the same context on every call.** `chat_request` and `prompt_token_ids` aren't kept between calls, so they go with every chunk including the usage chunk. Both are required when a tool or reasoning parser is configured. `prompt_token_ids` is the `token_ids` of the `GenerateRequest` returned by `/render`.
 - **Send `prompt_token_ids` on the first chunk, even without a parser.** It seeds detokenization so the first token's leading space matches the coupled endpoint (see [Request format](#request-format)). Later chunks already carry that context in `stream_state`.
 - **Don't forward `[DONE]`.** It marks the end of the generate stream and isn't a chunk.

issue_comments.body:
@sagearc Mostly a missing field. For `n = 1` the state contract is enough: replay rebuilds the parser and the count matches `/v1/chat/completions`.

`n > 1` is a real contract gap: `stream_state` is per index, but usage needs a total over all choices. Fixing it means changing the contract, which I'd rather not do in a bugfix PR, so this PR leaves it `null`.

This pull request has merge conflicts that must be resolved before it can be
merged. Please rebase the PR, @nien-hui.
